summary: TSMC (NYSE: TSM) announced via Form 6-K its plan to sell up to 152.0 million common shares of Vanguard International Semiconductor (VIS), representing about 8.1% of VIS's fully-diluted paid-in-capital, via a block trade to institutional investors. TSMC currently holds 27.1% of VIS; post-sale its stake will fall to ~19%. TSMC states the sale is to refocus on core businesses, will not affect strategic relations (outsourcing interposer production, GaN licensing), and no further VIS sales are planned. As a non-US filing, this 6-K serves as the equivalent of a material event disclosure. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is mentioned. The mechanics are an underwritten block trade, not a registered offering. Risk-arb: watch market reception and block trade pricing relative to VIS's last trade; no regulatory hurdles expected.
